## What's new
- **PC Details: faster registry reads.** When a PC's Remote Registry service can be reached, PC Details reads the registry through it instead of WMI. Each read is much cheaper, so the OS version, UAC, GPO dates, Office and software versions come back faster, especially for software found through Programs & Features. If the service is disabled, PC Details uses WMI as before.
- **Programs & Features is read in parallel**, so software entries that use `uninstall` in `software.json` load faster.
- **Load-time tooltip shows the registry route.** Hover the load time in the header to see "Registry connect (Remote Registry service)" or "(WMI StdRegProv)".

## Upgrading from v5.1.1
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.
- The Remote Registry service is disabled by default on Windows 10/11. Enable it with Group Policy if you want the faster route; nothing else changes if you don't.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.1.2-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.

## Requirements
- Windows 10/11 x64, domain-joined
- RSAT Active Directory tools (for AD Console)
- PowerShell 7 recommended for Remote PS and SFC Scan (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is used as a fallback)
- Target PCs: WinRM, the `c$` admin share and WMI/RPC reachable; `AllowRemoteRPC = 1` for Send Message
